title: External services as named parties with contracts and budgets
note: An egress grant answers 'may this reach that host'. That is the right question when the far side is anonymous and the wrong one when it is a service somebody depends on, because then which service, what may it be asked, and how much are three questions a grant cannot express. Each mutation here removes one of them.

mutations.name: V1_an_uncontracted_operation_is_permitted
mutations.rationale: a grant covering /v1 covers every operation under it, including ones nobody reviewed

mutations.name: V2_the_quota_is_not_enforced
mutations.rationale: a retry loop against somebody else's rate limit is an outage you caused

mutations.name: V3_the_quota_is_shared_across_tasks
mutations.replace:
used = sum(v for (s, _t), v in self._service_calls.items()
                       if s == svc.service_id)
mutations.rationale: one task exhausting a service stops every other task using it, which turns a budget into a global outage switch

mutations.name: V4_a_refused_call_spends_the_budget
mutations.rationale: a mistake costs a task the calls it never made, and a caller that gets the path wrong once loses its whole budget

mutations.name: V5_the_budget_resets_on_restart
mutations.find:
if ev.action == ACT_NET_REQUEST:
            # QUOTA IS COUNTED FROM THE LOG.
mutations.replace:
if False:
            # QUOTA IS COUNTED FROM THE LOG.
mutations.rationale: the one moment a task most needs its budget to be the one it had before is the moment a process comes back

mutations.name: V6_registering_a_service_widens_the_grant
mutations.find:
for gid in candidates:
            ok, why = self._covers(gid, req)
mutations.rationale: BOTH must permit; a service that could authorize on its own would be a way to route around every grant by registering a contract

mutations.name: V8_a_service_registrations_digest_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: the contract's content and the digest anything cites stop having to agree

mutations.name: V9_an_empty_contract_may_be_registered
mutations.rationale: an empty operation set is almost always a serialization failure, and registering it puts a contract that permits nothing in force

mutations.name: V10_a_quota_of_zero_is_accepted
mutations.find:

            or isinstance(quota_per_task, bool) or quota_per_task < 1):
mutations.rationale: a denial wearing a contract's name: the service is registered and nothing may ever call it

mutations.name: V11_operation_paths_match_as_strings
mutations.rationale: /v1/records does not cover /v1/records-admin, and a string prefix test grants it

mutations.name: V12_the_second_reader_does_not_count_the_budget
mutations.find:

mutations.rationale: the budget the scheduler believes is spent and the one the log shows stop being two numbers that can be compared

mutations.name: V13_the_second_reader_accepts_a_replaced_contract
mutations.rationale: the independent reader agrees with a substitution the authority refuses

mutations.name: V14_the_read_guard_exempts_everything
mutations.rationale: the guard that forces reads through GovernedReader passes by examining nothing, which is the vacuous-success shape this repository already carries once
